'''Univamp StarParts''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] repair and parts seller located on [[East Cliff]] at the [[Betha II Starport]]. Univamp StarParts was owned by the [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] [[Gwinnec Strov]].
